Subject: Apex Holdings

Trinity Capital has gotten back to me and is vacillating on what they want to do with the Apex Holdings trades.  In particular, they haven't thought through what they want to do with the online trades, don't like the online documentation, and now they think they may want to do a full novation of the trades once they decide how to resolve this.  So, until we hear back from them (they said in about a week), just let the Bankers Trust financial trades and master sit.
